question: What is the result of asuri birth and hatred?
premises: Asuri-born deluded ones do not reach the Lord.
They go to the lowest destination.
Hating ones act harmfully and cause hell-fall.
inference: Asuri birth and hatred lead to lowest destination and hell-fall.
uncertainties: Fused tokens are kept as single rows.
plain_english: Born in asuri wombs, deluded ones fail to reach me and go to the lowest state; hating ones act harmfully and cause hell-fall, so I cast them into asuri wombs.
